newsitem.title: USA: Tyco sees strong fiscal year earnings gains.
newsitem.headline: Tyco sees strong fiscal year earnings gains.

text.p: Tyco International Ltd on Wednesday said that growth in core units and recently acquired divisions will likely result in strong earnings increases through the rest of its fiscal year.

"The first quarter results give us confidence that Tyco will produce strong earnings increases for each of the remaining quarters of this fiscal year," said L. Dennis Kozlowski, Tyco's chairman and chief executive.

Earlier, the company said that net income for its first quarter ended September 30, 1996, increased 26 percent to a record $83.1 million, or 54 cents per share, against $65.7 million, or 43 cents per share for the same period last year.

"These increases will be possible as the positive effects of recently completed acquisitions, such as Carlisle Plastics, and three waterworks valve businesses begin to impact our results, coupled with continued strong growth in our existing businesses," Mr. Kozlowski said.
